QuestInfo.name: Teo's Advice
QuestInfo.parent: Information about the Slumbering Dragon Island
QuestInfo.0: #p1002001# says that it won't be easy getting to the island marked on the map. There must be some other way. Ask #b#p1002001##k again.
QuestInfo.1:
According to #p1002001#, there's only one sailor on #m104000000# with the skill to reach the spot marked on the map... #b#p1002101##k. But it might take some convincing. Maybe some #t4032470# items, which you can find at #b#m104000002##k, will encourage #p1002101# to help you.

#i4032526# #t4032526# #b#c4032526# / 1#k
#i4032470# #t4032470# #b#c4032470# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: #p1002101# gladly agreed to sail after receiving the #t4032470#.

0.0: Must you go to the island on this map? If so, I can't help you. But I know someone who might be able to... #b#p1002101##k. He's retired now, but #p1002101# is the best crew member I know.
0.1: Like I said, #p1002101# retired a long time ago. He doesn't miss it much, either... He may not want to help you, but I know something that might change #p1002101#'s mind.

yes.0: Bring #p1002101# some #t4032470# and he might change his mind. No promises, but if you want to give it a try... Go to #b#m104000002##k get collect some #b#t4032470##k.

no.0: Hm, I guess you're not THAT interested.

1.0: Ah, I don't think we've met. But you seem quite competent. It's rare to find someone so strong that I haven't trained myself. But what brings you here? Eh? You want me to take you to the island on this map?
1.1: Hahaha, someone must have told you that I was the best crew member in town! But I'm retired. I don't have any desire to get back on a ship. I'm just here to guide adventurers and offer advice.
1.2: W-what? Isn't this...#t4032470#? Ahem. Where did you get this? Ooh, it smells heavenly. Are you offering it to me?

yes.0: Haha, what a generous person you are! Alright, why not? I'll take you to the island on the map. It'll be a nice change of pace.
yes.1: Wait, where is this island? Let me look at the map again.

npc.0: Haven't you gone to see Olaf? Don't go empty-handed. Take him some #b#t4032470##k or something. You'll be able to get some in #b#m104000002##k.

item.0: Hm, what is it? I don't mind guiding a beginner adventurer, but you are much too strong to be a beginner...

lost.0: You're clumsy. Look, you dropped the map. Here, don't lose it again.
